# first-publish-creates-orphan-branch

On the first publish the publisher creates a new orphan branch named knowledge/wiki (a commit with no parents), includes '[skip ci]' in the commit message, and pushes that branch to the configured remote.

Ensure an initial snapshot of the published content is captured in a dedicated branch and avoid running CI for automated publisher commits; make the branch available on the remote.
